hni_signals: Elite Indian training pedigree, all three stages at top-tier national institutes: MBBS Osmania Medical College Hyderabad, MS General Surgery PGIMER Chandigarh, MCh Neurosurgery AIIMS New Delhi (2018), plus a Fellowship in Epilepsy and Functional Neurosurgery at AIIMS (2019-2021). Publicly stated seniority: 'Senior Consultant Neurosurgeon' in the title of his own AIG profile page and in his own LinkedIn headline. Subspecialty is high-capital robotic and neuromodulation surgery - robotic stereotactic surgery, robotic thermocoagulative hemispherotomy, vagal nerve stimulation, spinal cord stimulation, baclofen pump placement - i.e. he is the credentialled operator on AIG's most expensive neurosurgical platforms, plus endoscopic keyhole spine surgery. MEDIA SIGNAL: quoted as the named expert voice in a nationally syndicated ANI newswire feature on keyhole spine surgery (26 May 2026), carried on aninews.in, Business Upturn, Business News This Week, WebIndia123 and Viestories - a deliberate media-profile signal. Research-active: publications on epilepsy surgery, functional neurosurgery and neuromodulation in journals including Neurology India and the Journal of Neurosurgery, including work on hypothalamic hamartoma and endocrinopathy; stated to have presented research on national and international fora. Registered with the Telangana Medical Council. Directory ratings publicly stated as 98% rating / 96% recommendation. No founder, owner, Director, Chairman or HOD title was found anywhere - he is a senior employed consultant, not a practice owner on the public record.
